note: Functions a predictive name promises more than the body delivers. Every entry needs a 'why' and a matching row in docs/SCAFFOLD_INVENTORY.md; tests/test_scaffold_inventory.py enforces both, so a new constant cannot be silenced by editing this file alone.

recorded.why: Returns SuperconductorDiscovery.REFERENCE_CANDIDATES, a fixed list of four literature superconductors (LaH10, YBCO, MgB2, H3S). The name promises a search over candidate space; the return is a citation list, which is why the docstring says 'Not a search' and docs/SCAFFOLD_INVENTORY.md tiers it as literature_lookup.

EvidenceTier.rank is a property indexing the fixed ordering _RANK (PROVED 0 .. UNRESOLVED 3). The ordering is a schema decision about evidence kinds, not a judgement passed on the caller's data, so the lookup is the intended behaviour.

The return is an analytical projection whose score is computed from GluzdovV6Config; RECYCLING_MEASUREMENT is the measured degree-register recycling record embedded as its stated basis, not the answer the caller reads.
